badges.title: First day
badges.desc: You've completed your first smoke-free day.

badges.title: Over the peak
badges.desc: Three days: you've put the most intense days of withdrawal behind you.

badges.title: Two weeks
badges.desc: You've been smoke-free for two weeks.

badges.title: One month
badges.desc: A month smoke-free: a big milestone.

badges.title: Two months
badges.desc: Your new habits are taking root.

badges.title: 90 days
badges.desc: You've completed the whole camp smoke-free.

badges.title: 10 cravings
badges.desc: You got through ten urges without smoking.

badges.title: 100 cravings
badges.desc: You've got through a hundred cravings; you know the waves now.

badges.title: First plan
badges.desc: You made your first If–Then plan.

badges.title: All lessons
badges.desc: You've completed all the skill lessons.

badges.title: 7-day check-in
badges.desc: You did your daily check seven days in a row.

badges.title: First 1,000 saved
badges.desc: The money you didn't spend on cigarettes has passed 1,000.

badges.title: Graduate
badges.desc: You've graduated from the Smoke-Free Camp.

jar.intro: Add the things you want to buy with the money you didn't spend on cigarettes. The progress bars fill up with your savings.

graduation.title: Congratulations, you're graduating!
graduation.text: For 90 days you decided again every day to stay smoke-free. This certificate is the sum of those decisions.
graduation.certLine: By completing the 90-day Smoke-Free Camp, you've stepped into a smoke-free life.
graduation.after: After graduation your counter, crisis tool, ALO 171 and all your tools are still here. Your journey continues with short monthly checks.
